column6: All three concerns owned by a named person, with a published rotation schedule, a decision rule, at least one escalation or override rule, and what each owner owes the team.
column9: Owners are named, but a concern is unowned, or the rotation, the escalation rule, or what each owner owes is missing.
column12: No named roles, or no decision rule.

column6: A restorative stepwise path with measurable triggers, accountability tied to PRs, reviews, or attendance, and inclusion norms covering how meetings let everyone contribute, how a teammate requests an accommodation, and how the team surfaces barriers.
column9: A conflict path with a step past talking directly exists, but a trigger is missing or not measurable, accountability is not tied to PRs, reviews, or attendance, or the inclusion norms leave out meetings, accommodations, or barriers.
column12: No conflict path, or no step past talking directly.

column6: Meeting times, which channel is used for what, and where decisions are recorded.
column9: Names meeting times and channels, but not which channel is used for what, or not where decisions are recorded.
column12: Missing, names no meeting time, or names no channel.

column6: In CONTRIBUTING.md: specific checks, each tied to the CI gate, hook, or test that enforces it; a gate not built yet is named with the sprint it lands in and its owner.
column9: A Definition of Done exists, but a check is tied to no CI gate, hook, or test and is not named as a gate still to be built, it is kept outside CONTRIBUTING.md, or it names gates the repository does not have without the sprint or the owner for them.
column12: Missing, or a restatement of "it works".

column3: The Definition of Done is scored in its own criterion; this one scores the other required sections of CONTRIBUTING.md and the AI context file.
column6: Every other required section of CONTRIBUTING.md is present and specific to the repository, with exact commands (or, for a command not built yet, the hook, CI job, or test suite that will add it) and stated values; the AI context file is published, and any part of it that cannot be written before there is code is listed with an owner.
column9: A required section of CONTRIBUTING.md is missing or generic (boilerplate text, placeholder commands), or the AI context file leaves gaps with no owner.
column12: Either file is missing, or CONTRIBUTING.md has no section specific to the repository.

column6: Names which tools each kind of data and code may enter, consistent with what the partner has stated about confidentiality (any NDA, the rules for their data, and which tools may see the code); where the partner has not stated it yet, the section gives the assumed boundary and the week the team will confirm it with the partner.
column9: Present, but leaves some data or code with no named tool boundary, does not match what the partner has stated, or, where the partner has not stated it yet, gives no assumed boundary or no week to confirm it.
column12: Missing, or written so that it would permit a confidentiality breach.

column6: 2 to 4 pages; headed by the required sections; every commitment is a single sentence a teammate could quote back.
column9: One of the three missing: outside the length, a section missing, or commitments buried in paragraphs.
column12: Two or more of the three missing.
